history.summary: Freehold 2BR at The Waterina, D14 Geylang/Eunos (680m to Dakota CC8), $2.35M at $1,788 PSF — ~6% below the $1,894 URA median, with a solid 6.06%/yr appreciation on a reasonable 46-txn series. But it's a 1314sqft oversized 2BR (high absolute price for the bedroom count) and the low technical score (556) flags weak value-for-ticket.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: freehold, 6.06%/yr over 46 txns (reliable), below-median PSF, 680m to Dakota Circle Line, Paya Lebar Central catalyst. But 1314sqft for a 2BR is heavily oversized, pushing the ticket to $2.35M — above the deepest-liquidity band for a two-bedder and only justifiable to a buyer who wants the space. 2005-built freehold is fine. Net: solid trend but you're paying a 3BR-sized ticket for a 2BR label.
red_flags: Oversized 1314sqft 2BR — $2.35M ticket is steep for two bedrooms, narrower buyer pool
Low technical score (556) signals weak value-for-price
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central regeneration and airbase relocation
